'''Maecine''' was a king of Eharon.

== History ==
He was King of Eharon around {{ab|500}}. Lan tells Mat he lived four to five hundred years before the Trolloc wars. This is the earliest memory Mat has from his trip through the [[Twisted redstone doorframe]].{{ref/book|5|22}}
